PRECONDITION (Sky 2026-10-27, 'yeah wiat'): ask for it only once ONE development player holds 064 A3's no-look items 1 (SSAO off for the play camera), 5 (depth texture by request + the sun flare off at play) and 7 (signals overlay camera as a pass), every face with the holed L2 shadow copies (F1, a5234fdb), 072-F with its surfaceDetail switch, and 072-G; and after the Studio CPU check (phase2 F5) passes. JsonUtility drops unknown keys silently: run-air-072.sh refuses a resolved plan or a player result whose variants lack surfaceDetail. PerfBuild resolves foci and stand-offs with each stop's own yaw. 1920x1080 windowed (GDD §11's bar). Verdict rules: plan.md 4.3, phase2.md 4.3 and 5, phase3.md 4. BRIEF 075 (Redline, 2026-10-28; briefs/075/redline.md): the player must also hold 074-H (colourways on walls and plinths only) and 075-A/B/C1-2 (DK_SpaceSky, DK Ocean, play bloom 1.05/0.45, road detail, T-K1, liveries). No 075 switch exists in PerfVariant yet: sky, ocean, playBloom, colourways (and liveries, not recommended) are PENDING (Latch), specified in briefs/075/redline/perf-075-pending.json and NOT written here, because JsonUtility would drop them and run each 075 A/B as a build against itself. surfaceDetail now also switches the road's detail pair (075-B), so every - every-flat includes it. Two stops added for 075 with existing fields only: wide-lamplight-30 (the worst colourway play view) and harbour-quay-30 (the water view for DK Ocean).
